Start your message with "[issue type], [urgency] —" then say what's happening and what you're doing right now. Example style: "supplies, urgent — water cart heading to section 112 right now." "medical, critical — dancer collapsed in Block C, paging first aid NOW." "morale, routine — energy drop in 204, sending hype squad."
